page_title: ETI 2-3 TOU | St Etienne v Toulouse 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+7' That's a well-taken pass by Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
90+6' The game is interrupted as Yann Gboho (Toulouse) is flagged offside.
90+5' Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) is penalised for holding. Thomas Leonard signals a set piece. Toulouse earn a free kick.
90+5' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
90+4' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90+4' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes.
90+3' Toulouse work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.

90+1' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Gautier Larsonneur makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! Toulouse force a corner. They send men into the box.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Thomas Leonard ignores the protests.
89' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
88' Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

87' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Gautier Larsonneur, who tips the ball around the post.
86' Substitution. Frank Magri is replaced by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Warren Kamanzi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Umit Akdag (Toulouse).
84' Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) gets a yellow card.
83' Djyilian N'Guessan (St Etienne) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Irvin Cardona.
82' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
82' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play. St Etienne are awarded a corner kick.
81' Frank Magri (Toulouse) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
80' St Etienne quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
77' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
74' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
72' Djibril Sidibe goes off the pitch and Rafik Messali (Toulouse) comes on.
70' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) for a tough tackle.
70' Thomas Leonard shows the yellow card to Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) for a heavy challenge.
70' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for an infringement.
69' Substitution. Ibrahima Wadji will be replaced by Benjamin Old (St Etienne).
69' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
68' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
65' A player from St Etienne commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.

63' 2 - 3 The ball hits the back of the net! Zuriko Davitashvili showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne) gets onto the scoresheets by sweetly heading it inside the left post – 2:3.
63' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) takes a short corner kick.
62' St Etienne seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
59' We are about to witness a substitution. Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) is replacing Joshua King.
58' 1 - 3 Goal! Joshua King produces a great pass that finds Yann Gboho (Toulouse) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the left side of the goal. 1:3.

56' Close! Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
55' Frank Magri (Toulouse) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul. St Etienne have a free kick.

54' Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
54' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) is about to take a corner kick.

53' Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) controls the ball and sets off to face the goalkeeper, but deep inside the box the ball bounces up on the uneven surface and makes him miss the strike, sending the ball well over the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
52' The ball is cleared after Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' CHANCE! Joshua King (Toulouse) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.
50' Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.

50' A neat pass finds Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the left side of the goal, but Gautier Larsonneur denies him with a good save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Toulouse.
47' Joshua King (Toulouse) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
46' Substitution. Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne) has come on for Maxime Bernauer.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
45+3' Frank Magri (Toulouse) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
45+2' Frank Magri whips the ball in and it arrives at the feet of Vincent Sierro (Toulouse), whose wild shot goes way over the crossbar.
45+1' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

45' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the right side of the goal, but he can't get the power to direct it past Guillaume Restes, who keeps it out. The linesman points to the corner flag, St Etienne are going to take it.
45' The ball possession at the moment is 58:42.
43' Thomas Leonard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse).
43' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
42' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
41' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

38' 1 - 2 Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes inside the right post. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:2.
37' A player from Toulouse commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
36' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Toulouse will take a throw-in.
36' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
34' The cross into the penalty area from Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
34' Great teamplay by St Etienne as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
30' Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Thomas Leonard didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

28' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Guillaume Restes pulls off a decent save to thwart him. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne have been awarded a corner kick.
28' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) brings his opponent down. Thomas Leonard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. St Etienne have a free kick.
27' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) attempts to find Benjamin Bouchouari, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
23' Eirik Horneland is forced to make a change. Aimen Moueffek is unable to continue due to injury, Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) comes on.

21' Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
21' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
17' The corner from Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) is intercepted by the defence.
15' 0 - 2 Joshua King (Toulouse) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.

13' The corner kick is deflected to Florian Tardieu (St Etienne), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
13' The resulting set piece from St Etienne is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
10' 0 - 1 Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
8' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
7' Toulouse take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

6' He should have scored! Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Toulouse.
3' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' St Etienne control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! St Etienne will take the kick-off.
Thomas Leonard will referee today's match.
